method: Six exact original published URLs from Oct 30 WordPress source; 6 original endpoints tested via independent web retriever Nov 10: 3 exact FHWA JPG rendered; 2 Commons redirects and NTSB JPG tool-inaccessible; original Commons catalogs + NTSB/FHWA primary HTML independently inspected. These are retriever-only observations, not direct origin/guest browser responses. No image downloads, rehosting or changed publication.

rows.published_alt: Silver Bridge spanning the Ohio River between Point Pleasant, West Virginia, and Ohio shortly after completion in 1928.
rows.source_authority: Wikimedia Commons describes original as Federal Highway Administration/U.S. DOT work; source link not independently resolved
rows.rights_observation: Commons PD-USGov-DOT assertion, but original government photographer/record not independently matched; item-level review HOLD

rows.max_width_rule: min(960, verified original pixel width); never upscale; for unknown originals HOLD
rows.visual_integrity_note: Original is only 286x154. Do not upscale to 960. File history states 2010 straightening; crop/scene identity not binary verified.
